owner_request: 2026-10-13 「多测试一些山寨币呢」, right after 「spike强劲爆发v1 ethusdt.p btcusdt.p 30min级别 5年详细的回测数据跑一下」
question: How did frozen SPIKE 强劲爆发 V1 (default long-only) perform on 30 liquid alts, Binance USD-M perpetuals 30m, from 2021-10-13 to 2026-10-01 after 0.2 percent round-trip cost, against matched random long entries with the same initial stop distance and trailing exit, pooled and per coin, in both periods?
single_variable: None; the same frozen rule, ledger engine, controls and statistics as exp-spike-v1-okx-30m-5y-20261013-v1 (its build.py helpers are imported), applied to a wider, pre-registered alt universe on Binance archives.
universe_rule: every USDT-quoted symbol in the data.binance.vision futures/um monthly klines listing (delisted symbols included), minus BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, quarterly contracts (names with '_'), stable or pegged assets and index contracts (config exclude); ranked by median daily quote volume (sum of close x volume per UTC day) in rank_month from that month's 30m archive (checksum verified); the top universe_size
ticks: PRICE_FILTER tickSize from data/kline_preholdout_binance_um5m/exchange_info.json (2026-08 snapshot) where the symbol is listed; otherwise the smallest positive gap between distinct prices in the symbol's archive, recorded as inferred. The tick only floors V1's initial stop.

controls.pool: same symbol and calendar month, bars with finite ATR, not the signal bar, ATR/close within 0.5-2x the signal bar's
controls.stop: entry minus the event's initial stop distance in signal-bar ATR units
controls.exit: trail_exit of exp-spike-v1-okx-30m-5y-20261013-v1/build.py for events and controls alike

primary: pooled 30 alts: net mean R positive in both periods and excess over matched random positive with month-block sign-flip p < 0.01 in both (the repo bar); per-coin rows and years are descriptive
notes: Binance, not OKX: OKX official 1m archives for 30 alts over five years are about 6 GB; Binance prices track OKX closely but signals can differ bar by bar. The OKX ETH/BTC study is the venue the owner charts.
The universe is ranked in 2021-09, before the window, so later winners are not picked with hindsight; symbols listed after 2021-09 are out by construction.
Funding, spread, impact and fee tiers are not modelled. No Pine, monitor, threshold preset, account or live behaviour change.
